{r-setup, include=FALSE} knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)

# lhs_analysis comparison - v1 (threshold = 0.001), v2 (threshold = 0.01)

# PCC and PRCC using v2 as df_lhs (combined in lhs_ouputs list)
lhs_outputs$plots$pcc()

lhs_outputs$plots$prcc()

# combined visualization
lhs_outputs$plots$pcc_all()

lhs_outputs$plots$prcc_all()

# model structure dominates behavior (so threshold is a second-order effect)
